en: A vintage monochrome postcard view of a broad city street intersection with tram lines and early electric trams. People stand and walk along wide sidewalks beside multi‑story European-style buildings with ornate facades and balconies. Trees line the street, and a man is pushing a cart in the foreground. At the top of the image, there is printed text in Bulgarian and French indicating the street name and city.
